kind: resident multi-role agent/workflow framework with notebook interpreter

runtime.execution: asyncio concurrent role rounds; model command maps; owned notebook kernels and persistent shells
runtime.service_boundary: owns resident team routing, memory, planning and computation; consumes model/browser/RAG services

summary: MetaGPT combines role SOP/react/planner workflows and model-controlled delegation with a separate Python notebook code-generation path. Its local team model is real collaboration but recovery snapshots do not preserve unresolved computation/effects.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: Team.hire / run_project / run / serialize / deserialize
actions.input: roles, idea, round limit/budget, snapshot path
actions.lifecycle: concurrent role rounds; exceptions snapshot selected state
actions.authority: Python author controls role implementations, configuration and budget

actions.name: Role.run / set_actions / react modes
actions.lifecycle: observe→think→act; base publishes at run end
actions.authority: role author chooses methods/actions, model can select states

actions.name: TeamLeader.publish_team_message
actions.output: peer inbox message; leader state reset
actions.lifecycle: resident message now, peer responds on scheduling round

actions.name: Plan.append_task / reset_task / replace_task / finish_current_task / end
actions.lifecycle: serial commands; planner review may clear working memory
actions.authority: RoleZero model configured with plan command map

actions.name: Editor.create_file / write / read / edit_file_by_replace / search_dir / similarity_search
actions.lifecycle: serial command map; catalog includes more editor navigation operations
actions.authority: configured RoleZero owns local editor capability

actions.name: Browser.goto / click / type / scroll / tab_focus / close_tab
Terminal.run_command / get_stdout_output / close
actions.output: text output; background queue; no stable job receipt
actions.lifecycle: persistent shell sentinel stream; daemon reader bug and EOF loop limits
actions.authority: Engineer2 map exposes terminal; substring exclusion not approval system

actions.name: DataInterpreter / ExecuteNbCode.run / terminate / reset
actions.input: Python code or markdown and timeout
actions.lifecycle: persistent kernel between cells; timeout interrupt; plan end terminates
actions.authority: model code can import/execute in owned local kernel

actions.name: ask_human / reply_to_human
actions.lifecycle: MGX local human input; no remote delivery proof in default reply
actions.authority: optional model human request; autonomous planner auto-run bypasses review

actions.name: Memory.get_by_content / try_remember / RoleZeroLongTermMemory.get
actions.output: matching resident or retrieved old messages
actions.lifecycle: mutable memory and optional retrieval dependency
actions.authority: role author; no dedicated model repair operation

filesystem.detail: RoleZero editor and Engineer2 terminal/code actions expose filesystem operations; notebook writes code.ipynb after cells.

processes.detail: Persistent terminal and notebook kernel are owned resident processes; terminal daemon has no handle and reader does not enable background queue, timeout or EOF termination.

code_actions.detail: DataInterpreter model writes executable Python cells with recommended tool information and retries against actual results.

persistent_kernel.detail: Notebook kernel reuses state across cells; timeout interrupts and dead-kernel reset loses live values; plan-and-act termination closes it at run end. Harness owns kernel rather than consuming independent shared service.

standing_database.detail: Optional Chroma/RAG memory supplies persistent retrieval of selected older messages; no general standing SQL/query interface traced in role/tool/kernel paths.

workflow_programming.detail: Python roles/actions, watch/route rules, reaction strategies and model-editable plans express workflows; role command maps are subclass-extensible.

multi_model.detail: Role/action private model/config can override shared context, permitting mixed-model peers.

live_collaboration.detail: Resident role inboxes, routed messages and TeamLeader model dispatch coordinate peers; RoleZero observes between actions. Standard environment is in-process, round-based, with optimistic route success.

concurrent_work.detail: Non-idle roles run concurrently via gather per round; model commands within each role are serial, and DataInterpreter cells share one executor.

steering_interrupt.detail: RoleZero picks up inbox news between actions and model ask_human stop ends role. Notebook timeout interrupts; exception snapshot is not global cancellation/drain of other role effects.

turn_redefinition.detail: Overridable observe/think/act/react, selectable strategies and mutable command map provide Python turn design; not a uniform model-exposed hot turn-program API.

compaction.detail: Provider offers configurable pre/post message/token truncation; RoleZero uses bounded recent memory and optional older retrieval. No managed compaction event, alternatives or revisioned projections.

context_repair.detail: Mutable memory queries, optional RAG and Team snapshot restore can recover selected state. Exception recovery deletes latest observed item to force reobservation, risking effect replay; no authoritative original/context revision repair.

original_audit.detail: Debug environment memory, masked provider logging, overwritten notebook and Team snapshots record selected state; memories delete/clear and recovery changes them. No full raw request/tool/process audit traced.

audit_query.detail: Role memory searches by content/cause/role and RAG retrieve selected messages; no durable full-event audit query.

hot_change.detail: Python role/tool/config setters support reconfiguration, but cached private model and mutable map have no affected-turn/workflow activation fence or source reload contract.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Selected Team/role state serializes after ordinary exceptions/KeyboardInterrupt, and observed message is made retryable; live kernel/terminal handles are excluded and unresolved external effects lack dedup receipts.

remote_services.detail: Provider services and optional browser/search/RAG extensions are consumed; peer environment, shell and notebook are locally owned. Remote MGX human methods explicitly require override.

self_improvement.detail: Experience cache and code error-repair loops plus editor/terminal allow programming improvements; no governed harness refit/research/adoption loop or compiled continuity traced.

complaints.detail: No dedicated model frustration report with captured agent state and separate tracked repair queue established in role, team, memory and tool paths inspected.

authority.detail: Mapped model commands execute directly; autonomous planner accepts successful code while manual reviewer may accept failures. Terminal substring exclusions and post-execution pip failure label are limited policy mechanisms.

evaluation.detail: Read notebook tests exercise real cross-cell variables, exception and timeout behavior; team serialization tests patch writer and assert reconstructed role types/count, not process/request/effect continuity.

time_order.detail: Round gather defines coarse barriers and role inbox/memory order; fixed shell sentinel and optimistic no-recipient publish cannot establish durable command/delivery causal receipts.

evidence.claim: Team hire/publish/run bounds rounds and budget; snapshot serialization records model data/context; normal run archives project Git, exception decorator handles snapshots.
Environment routes to resident role inboxes, appends debug memory and returns True even without recipients; non-idle role.run coroutines gather concurrently per round.
Role selects fixed/order/model actions and observes watched/direct messages after inbox pop; history is role memory, with latest observed item retained for recovery.
Base role chooses ReAct/order/plan-and-act; planner loops tasks, role memory is updated and final response is published to peers.
MGX leader/direct/public routing rewrites message content; ask_human reads local input; reply_to_human returns claimed success string without transport delivery implementation.
Model-visible publish_team_message targets named peer and resets leader state to wait; live room is resident environment, not remote IRC transport.
RoleZero initializes autonomous planner, exposes plan/human/editor/browser command map and subclass extensions.
RoleZero builds plan/tool/context request, processes observations and calls configured LLM through optional experience cache; memory subset and output normalization affect prompt.
RoleZero parses model command list, stores response/results, observes new inbox items between actions and can ask human to extend large action bound.
Command map invokes coroutine/sync functions serially; first unknown/error breaks batch; end/finish/human/terminal handled specially, human stop invokes end.
Normal Engineer2 exposes native terminal plus code write/review/fix and pull/deploy functions, extending RoleZero map.
DataInterpreter produces and executes notebook code with three-attempt repair, stores code/results in working memory; plan completion/error terminates kernel.
Executor starts a notebook kernel and reuses it; terminate kills it and clears handles; reset terminates/builds new kernel rather than replaying old values.
Cell timeout interrupts and reports failure; dead kernel resets; Python/markdown cells persist notebook to fixed code.ipynb. Executed pip is marked failure after execution, not blocked before.
Terminal owns persistent shell, substring-filters forbidden commands and appends sentinel. Daemon launches reader without passing daemon=True, so expected queue path is not enabled.

Reader consumes stdout until fixed sentinel; EOF loops instead of breaking; no timeout/exit-code result. Background queue is populated only when reader daemon argument True; close waits without escalation.
Provider request formatting logs masked debug prompt, applies configured truncation and awaits completion; debug logging is not raw immutable request audit.
Configurable pre/post token/message cuts retain system prefix and earliest/latest content; token allowance becomes character slicing at cutoff, no compaction event/repair revision.
Role/action private configuration and provider override shared context; lazy private model permits different peer models but configuration changes do not automatically replace cached provider.
Team exception wrapper logs then serializes; role exceptions delete latest observed message so it can be reobserved. No external-effect receipt or idempotency prevents repeated action effects.
Memory supports mutable add/delete/clear and content/role/cause lookup; transcript is in-memory mutable state, not complete audit.
Optional RoleZero Chroma memory stores selected older messages and retrieves related messages for a new requirement under conditions; not authoritative transcript repair.
Auto review accepts successful TaskResult; manual confirmation can accept failed code and successful task clears working memory.

tests.focus: Cross-cell state, arithmetic exception, timeout and termination
tests.oracle: Source invokes actual notebook kernel: later cell asserts z==3, division fails, timeout prefix and cleared kernel handle asserted; tests unexecuted here, do not prove shared service/refit.
Pydantic dump/validate checks role types; save/recover tests patch Team.serialize to different mock writer. No live process, tool-effect or provider-request recovery oracle.

strengths: Model-editable plans and per-role provider overrides support heterogeneous workflow teams.
Notebook executes model-authored cells with shared variable state and result-driven repair.
RoleZero re-observes peer/operator messages between actions.
limits: Local round-based routing reports success even with no recipient; default human reply returns success without transport.
Terminal background reader omits daemon flag, so advertised queue stays unpopulated on that path; EOF can loop indefinitely.
Exception recovery reobserves message without external-effect idempotency; live kernel/shell excluded from snapshots.
Compaction is token/message cutting; memory/snapshot/notebook are mutable selected-state records.
arconaut_questions: Should collaboration scheduling use independent participants rather than gather barriers?
How should computation ownership move to shared independent kernels without losing code/result ergonomics?
What durable effect receipts make role recovery safe when an action partly completed?
